title: Special permit for 629 West 54th Street, Manhattan
summary: This application would grant a special permit allowing about 84,349 square feet of floor area to be transferred from Hudson River Park sites to a development site at 629 West 54th Street in Manhattan, and would modify height and setback rules for the project. It supports a proposed mixed-use development of roughly 506,000 square feet of floor area and would help fund improvements and maintenance in Hudson River Park.
